attributes.text: Global telecom services connecting enterprises across Asia, the Middle East, Europe, and beyond.

Victor Huang is the founder of Vocom International Telecommunications, Inc. He founded Vocom in Taipei in 1993, later expanding into Shenzhen and helping China Mobile, China Telecom, and China Unicom establish their early international operations. In 1998, Victor incorporated Vocom in the U.S., building it into a facilities-based carrier operating under license from the FCC’s International Bureau. Over more than three decades, he has worked with carrier partners on every continent except Antarctica, and Vocom today routes voice, data, fiber, mobile, and AI infrastructure for partner carriers across six continents, from wholesale IDD termination in 1998 to Supermicro AI compute today. Vocom remains entirely self-funded, running a modern facility staffed by an in-house team of telecom engineers trained to hold Quality of Service levels across every carrier route.

attributes.altText: Kevin Huang, Founder of Vocom AI

attributes.text: Kevin Huang is the founder of Vocom AI, the AI-focused division of Vocom International. He leads go-to-market and product strategy across a full-stack deployment model spanning GPU and AI server infrastructure, data center integration, and custom AI software, giving customers one accountable partner instead of three disconnected vendors. His background spans product management and sales across telecom and AI infrastructure. He is fluent in English and Mandarin and holds a degree from the University of Southern California’s Marshall School of Business.
A closer look at what each business line delivers.
